method.shade: Share of points every 5 m where ≥20% of a 5 m disk (9 m on roads) has canopy ≥3 m tall.
method.slope: Steepest grade over any 30 m stretch, from elevation sampled every 10 m. Bridges and tunnels are left blank.
method.amenities: Counted when within 20 m (benches), 25 m (water, shelters, picnic tables) or 50 m (restrooms) of the segment.
method.points_of_interest: Viewpoints and points of interest within 40–60 m of the segment.
method.water: Share of points every 10 m within 40 m of a mapped river, stream, canal or water body.
method.parks: Share of points every 10 m inside a mapped park, garden or nature reserve.
